dct_creator_sm: Regional District of North Okanagan GIS Open Data Site.
dct_description_sm: This data set contains the line work and point files that make up the Greater Vernon Water Utility data for the water network. The features captured include pipes, valves, PRV's, Pumps and Reservoirs.
